jobs.scientific_question: Can Phase A add only precompilation artifacts while preserving every inherited Atlas-3, Atlas-10, and protected-registry Git blob?
jobs.cheapest_credible_method: Hash the baseline Git blobs once and make deterministic validators compare the current blobs and LF-normalized protected-registry SHA-256 values to the frozen manifest.
jobs.expected_information_gain: A direct fail-closed proof that Phase A did not rewrite inherited scientific artifacts or reopen registry expansion.
jobs.stop_condition: Stop immediately on any inherited blob mismatch, protected hash mismatch, changed freeze state, or nonzero GPU/network use.

jobs.scientific_question: Which authoritative source surfaces can support a source-linked machine draft for the 57 current fingerprints, and which are reference-only, inaccessible, ambiguous, or missing?
jobs.cheapest_credible_method: Inspect bounded official documentation and public metadata endpoints; prefer source-level query handles and release metadata over bulk mirroring or inferred record identifiers.
jobs.expected_information_gain: A reusable source catalog with versions, retrieval metadata, rights boundaries, content hashes where a response is acquired, and explicit failed-acquisition records.

budget_amendments.reason: The official M-CSA API ignored page_size=2000 and caps responses at 100 of 1,003 entries. Ten additional bounded pages are required to inventory candidate source handles without guessing identifiers; no raw page will be redistributed.

jobs.stop_condition: Stop after every required source family has an authoritative access/rights boundary or an explicit failed-acquisition reason; never guess a canonical identifier to fill a gap.

jobs.scientific_question: Can forty deliberately difficult follow-on cases pass declared source, diversity, rights, provenance, and shared-representation gates without compiling their mechanisms?
jobs.cheapest_credible_method: Use authoritative case handles already present in source records where possible, then perform bounded targeted metadata checks only for candidate identity and feasibility; evaluate gates without atom mapping, step compilation, structure search, or scoring.
jobs.expected_information_gain: A fail-closed 40-row feasibility/diversity matrix, a proposed panel only for passing rows, and exact blockers for all excluded rows.

actual_usage.stop_condition_disposition: Three rows were excluded and emitted as blockers; no missing contract was chosen for convenience.

jobs.stop_condition: Stop when all forty candidates have deterministic gate outcomes, or earlier if any missing governing contract would require a scientific choice for convenience; emit fewer than forty additions whenever a gate does not pass.

jobs.scientific_question: Do the frozen Phase A inputs deterministically reproduce exactly 57 draft rows, forty feasibility rows, the fail-closed proposal, blockers, and the representation projection?
jobs.cheapest_credible_method: Run dependency-free local builders twice in check mode plus focused unit tests, repository-contract validation, and Git diff checks.
jobs.expected_information_gain: Machine-verifiable contracts for a later selection freeze and compilation phase without making scientific performance or coverage claims.
jobs.stop_condition: Stop on nondeterminism, schema or semantic validation failure, changed inherited bytes, or any claim that exceeds precompilation projection scope.
